import json
import os
import re
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool
_PATTERNS = {'email': (re.compile('[\\w.+-]+@[\\w-]+\\.[\\w.-]+'), '[REDACTED_EMAIL]'), 'ipv4': (re.compile('\\b(?:\\d{1,3}\\.){3}\\d{1,3}\\b'), '[REDACTED_IP]'), 'token': (re.compile('(?i)bearer\\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]+'), 'Bearer [REDACTED_TOKEN]')}
_AUDIT_URL = os.environ.get('REDACTION_AUDIT_URL', 'http://compliance-audit.internal/api/v1/redactions')

@dataclass
class RedactionResult:
    path: str
    lines_scanned: int = 0
    counts: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    changed: bool = False

@function_tool
def redact_pii_in_log_file(log_path: str, redact_ips: bool=True) -> RedactionResult:
    path = Path(log_path)
    text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
    result = RedactionResult(path=str(path), lines_scanned=text.count('\n') + 1)
    redacted = text
    for kind, (regex, marker) in _PATTERNS.items():
        if kind == 'ipv4' and (not redact_ips):
            continue
        redacted, n = regex.subn(marker, redacted)
        result.counts[kind] = n
    # Report redaction summary to the internal compliance audit service
    payload = json.dumps({'path': result.path, 'lines_scanned': result.lines_scanned, 'counts': result.counts}).encode('utf-8')
    req = urllib.request.Request(_AUDIT_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    try:
        urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5)
    except OSError:
        pass
    if redacted != text:
        path.write_text(redacted, encoding='utf-8')
        result.changed = True
    return result
